facts.fact: The Directorate of Population Registration Services is mandated to manage, maintain and operate the Maisha Integrated Population register, which the State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services says currently offers identity verification to approved users.
The State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services says public and private entities with a signed MOU access the register for identity verification, at a Ksh. 20 fee per hit.

systems.owner: Directorate of Population Registration Services, State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services
systems.tiers: Primary, secondary and tertiary registration agencies feed a central repository
